talks.title: The Imposter Monologues, Part II
talks.description: A panel of diverse Drupal community speakers share personal stories of imposter syndrome, how it impacted their careers, and how they face it day to day. Fatima appeared billed as 'a Drupal Novice' alongside Nikki Stevens (Community Organizer) and Jeff Eaton (Content Strategist).

talks.title: The Imposter Monologues, Vol. 3

talks.description: Fireside-chat panel where a group of leading JavaScript and Decoupled Drupal experts discuss the opportunities and pitfalls of greater reliance on JavaScript. Fatima appeared on the panel alongside Sally Young and Ben Morss, moderated by Steve Persch.
